label: Evidence-2
title: BBC live page, 18:30 UTC: '32 government services were unavailable and four partially unavailable'; 'globally 90_ of systems at risk are yet to do so'
description: Fetched by the desk; the vault's three BBC captures end at 08:05 UTC and carry neither line. The minister is not named on the page, and 'House of Lords' (in the coverage review) is not on it. The 90% is attributed only to 'researchers'. Capture the page as it stands.

properties.excerpt: a minister said just after midday that 32 government services were unavailable and four partially unavailable because they were being fixed
